So column 1 has 1 at rows 0,2,4,6,8. Column 0 has 1 at rows 1,5,9. Column 2 has 1 at rows 3,7.

Let's think of this as diagonal lines bouncing. The bottom block at (9,0). From there, go up-right at 45°: (9,0) -> (8,1) -> (7,2). Then bounce off right wall (col 2) go up-left: (7,2) -> (6,1) -> (5,0). Then bounce off left wall: (5,0) -> (4,1) -> (3,2). Then bounce: (3,2) -> (2,1) -> (1,0). Then bounce: (1,0) -> (0,1).

So it's a bouncing diagonal starting at the blue block, moving upward alternating direction, reflecting off walls.
